description.narrative: The development objective of the Road Rehabilitation Project for Kiribati is to improve the condition of South Tarawa's main road network and help strengthen road financing and maintenance capacity. There are three components to the project. The first component of the project is infrastructure improvements. This component consists of the main civil works activities to be undertaken on the South Tarawa road infrastructure including the reconstruction and rehabilitation of Paved Roads on South Tarawa; and rehabilitation of Betio causeway. The second component of the project is road sector reform. This component helps to keep the activities to strengthen the road sector and ultimately lead to more sustainable main road infrastructure in South Tarawa. The third component of the project is project support. This includes: 1) establishment of a project management unit to ensure smooth operation of the project; 2) project associated incremental operating costs; 3) a valuation specialist to identify the appropriate compensation rates for trees and other assets affected by the project; and 4) audit of the project accounts.
The project will improve the condition of South Tarawa's main road network and help strengthen road financing and maintenance capacity.

title.narrative: Component B - Intermediate Result Indicator 1: Number of micro-enterprises for routine road maintenance in South Tarawa commercially active for two or more consecutive years

comment.narrative: <p>Partially achieved as maintenance approach switched to subcontracting. Contracts with three local subcontractors are signed and works have commenced. Planning for transition to management by MISE has commenced with the support of the maintenance consultant.</p>

title.narrative: Component A - Intermediate Result Indicator 3: Number of kilometers of unpaved roads improved

comment.narrative: <p>Target achieved. Although not reported here, the remaining 0.2 km (at the southern end of the Buota road) were also treated under the project, albeit sealed instead of improved.</p>

title.narrative: Component A - Intermediate Result Indicator 2: Number of kilometers of unpaved roads paved

comment.narrative:
<p>The original target was incorrectly assigned due to uncertainty regarding the historic surfacing at Temaiku. The target is considered as fully achieved, one year before the end of the project.</p>
<p> </p>

title.narrative: Component A - Intermediate Result Indicator 1: Number of kilometers of paved roads improved

comment.narrative: <p>Target exceeded by 35 percent. Additional works (mostly in Betio) increased the total length of paved roads improved by 9.2 km, leading to 35.3 km actual achieved at completion.</p>
<p>Target exceeded by 30 percent, one year before closing. Additional works (mostly in Betio) increased the total length of non-rural road rehabilitated by 10 km to 42.70 km.</p>

title.narrative: Number of kilometers of roads under regular maintenance

comment.narrative: <p>Target achieved, although there are 7.4 km less under routine maintenance compared with what was originally planned (56km). This is because some sections of road included at the time of project inception for ongoing maintenance were excluded during project implementation : (i) the Nippon Causeway was under rehabilitation, and (ii) the condition of some sections of the main road north of the Bonriki Airport and some secondary roads was deemed not suitable for inclusion in the routine maintenance contracts.</p>

<p>Original revised target was based on incorrectly classified rural roads. It should have consisted of Buota Road and original unpaved section of Temaiku Road which has an actual total length of 5.8 km, which was achieved one year before the end of the project.</p>

title.narrative: Component A - Intermediate Result Indicator 6: Length of additional footpath

comment.narrative: <p>Indicator target achieved. Due to a design change, 10.2 km of footpath were dropped (in some locations, mostly at Temaiku, where there is still single direction footpath) from the 2015 Level 2 restructuring dual direction footpath target.</p>

title.narrative: Roads in good and fair condition as a share of total classified roads
Component A - Intermediate Result Indicator 5: Number of speed humps

comment.narrative: <p>The actual achieved target for number of speed humps was more than double. This is because the target was set based on design drawings, which didn’t show the locations of all humps.</p>

title.narrative: Component A - Intermediate Result Indicator 4: Average travel speed St. Anne's to Ananau Causeway

comment.narrative: <p>77 percent of the target achieved. The 11 km/h improvement over the baseline shows a significant improvement, while to achieve the target average speed the speed limit would need to be exceeded.</p>

title.narrative: Component B - Intermediate Result Indicator 3: Drafting of Revised Road Safety Legislation

comment.narrative: <p>Achieved. After being endorsed by cabinet and passing two readings in parliament, the draft legislation prepared under the project was passed into law in August 2017.</p>

title.narrative: Component B - Intermediate Result Indicator 2: Adoption and implementation of National Road Safety Action Plan

baseline.value: No National Road Safety Action Plan

target.value: (i) Prepare the strategy by 2014; (ii) Adopt the strategy by 2015; (iii) Plan under implementation by 2016

comment.narrative: <p>Partly achieved. Vehicle inspection labels delivered to KPS for implementation. Agreement has been reached with Queensland Police Service for provision and training in use of radar detection and breathalyzer units. Public awareness campaigns were done.</p>

title.narrative: An agreed plan for reform of road sector management and financing under implementation

target.value: (i) GoK agrees on plan for sector reform by 2015; (ii) Sector reform plan under implementation by 2016

actual.value: Final plan provided. Some reforms under implementation.
